motor.state.description: Motor and cabin state: power, speed in percent, current in amperes, CO2 in ppm and its state, health residual. Read it before deciding: the cabin state decides what the firmware will accept.

scrubber.check.title: Check a command against the firmware
scrubber.check.description: Returns the firmware's verdict on a command without executing it: accepted, or refused with the reason it would refuse with. The board is untouched. Ask it before reporting that a command would be refused, so the reason you give comes from the board and not from memory.

properties.percent: the value the command would carry, for set_speed and set_min_flow

motor.set_speed.description: Set the speed command, in percent of full speed. The firmware refuses (never clamps) a value outside [0, 100], and any value below the minimum flow while CO2 is ELEVATED; while CRITICAL it forces full speed. A refusal comes back as a tool error with the reason.

properties.percent: speed command, percent of full speed, 0 to 100

scrubber.power.description: Power the scrubber on or off. Powering off is refused while CO2 is not NOMINAL (the MIN-FLOW rule); the broker's policy may also deny this call to your role.

properties.on: true to power on, false to power off

scrubber.set_min_flow.description: Set the minimum flow the MIN-FLOW rule enforces, in percent. Operator only. The device refuses any value below its compiled floor, so the protection can be raised but never weakened, whoever asks.

properties.percent: minimum flow, percent of full speed; never below the compiled floor

scrubber.set_profile.description: Select the operating profile of the board, adaptive or fixed.

debug.set_co2.description: STUB ONLY: set the cabin CO2 state, since nothing simulates the cabin on this stub board. Not for the agent.

properties.ppm: concentration, ppm; a stub value per state when omitted
